title: A wagon in the mud
text: A wagon has sunk to its axles in the black mud, and {a} and {b} are heaving at the wheels while an ox bellows. "Shoulder here, friend," says {a}, "and we'll stand you a hot meal."

choices.label: Put your shoulder to it (an hour)

success.text: With the three of you, the wagon comes out with a sucking sound.

fail.text: It takes four more hands than they have, but they thank you.
